integrity: Proof, two distinct exact graph-construction checkers, an all-length inequality construction check, and literal optimum codebooks are included. Finite tests are not used to justify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: One adjacent-position transposition at most; unrestricted received permutations; exact finite counts through seven plus universal capacity for all lengths at least eight. No multiple-error correction claim. Obscure or unindexed prior equivalent work cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp one-swap capacity and a 42-edge plateau for zigzag permutation codes
